packageRules.description: uv locks the newest in-range release, not the one Renovate targeted, so Renovate rejects the lockfile an in-range update writes. :pinDevDependencies misses PEP 735 groups
uv builds with its bundled uv_build only while the build-system range admits uv's own version, so the two move in one pull request
A pull request held for review picks up main's fixes only by rebasing. A matching package rule from an extended preset overrides a top-level rebaseWhen
